title: Non-intrusive spectral submanifold model reduction for geometrically nonlinear rotating structures with Coriolis and centrifugal forces
summary: Rotating structures are widely observed in engineering applications such as turbomachinary and wind turbine. These rotating structures, particularly for blades made by lightweight materials, can undergo large deformation in operations and display complex nonlinear dynamics under the coupling interaction of geometric nonlinearity, Coriolis effect and centrifugal force.
